preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in [n, m, q]) and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in T) and all(1 <= int(x) <= 1e9 for x in T) and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in [x_i, y_i, k_i] for line in queries for x_i, y_i, k_i in line.split())
preconditions.description: Input dimensions n, m, q are positive integers within bounds; city types T_i are positive integers; queries x_i, y_i, k_i are valid city indices and k_i is a positive integer.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 3 and all(int(x) >= 1 for x in line.split()) for line in roads) and all(len(line.split()) == 3 for line in queries)
preconditions.description: Each road is defined by three positive integers (x_i, y_i, u_i) where x_i ≠ y_i; each query is defined by three integers (x_i, y_i, k_i).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(u) <= 1e9 for line in roads for u in line.split()[2:])
preconditions.description: Each road's crowd value u_i is a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout_line.strip()) > 0 and (int(stdout_line.strip()) == -1 or int(stdout_line.strip()) >= 1) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each query, stdout contains exactly one line with either -1 (no valid path) or a positive integer representing the minimum crowd value of a valid path.

postconditions.expression: all(any(all(T[city] == T[prev_city] for city, prev_city in zip(path[1:], path[:-1])) or any(T[city] != T[prev_city] for city, prev_city in zip(path[1:], path[:-1]))) for path in valid_paths) and all(len(set(T[city] for city in path)) >= k for path in valid_paths) and all(max(crowd_values[road] for road in path_roads) == crowd_value for path, path_roads, crowd_value in valid_paths_with_crowd)
postconditions.description: For each query (x_i, y_i, k_i), if a valid path exists, the output is the minimum crowd value among all paths from x_i to y_i that include at least k_i distinct building types (T_i values). A valid path is a sequence of cities starting at x_i and ending at y_i, where the path's crowd value is the maximum crowd value of its roads. If no such path exists, output is -1.

postconditions.expression: all(crowd_value == min(max(crowd_values[road] for road in path_roads) for path, path_roads in valid_paths) if valid_paths else -1 for (x_i, y_i, k_i), crowd_value, valid_paths in zip(queries, stdout_lines, valid_paths_list))
postconditions.description: The output for each query is the minimum crowd value among all valid paths (as defined in Q2) or -1 if no valid path exists.
